coverage_verification.note: v2 (msg 140 correction round): the verifier no longer only checks weekday-ness and set membership. It derives every contract's real snapshot file path from the manifest, reads the actual pinned CSV rows, and confirms each registered anchor date is a genuine present observation in every one of its declared source files, plus a real >4-calendar-day surrounding-gap check against those same rows — not a declarative claim.
coverage_verification.verifier_checks: Per-family {1,2,3,5} outage-length coverage in BOTH development and holdout splits; minimum 2 holdout entries per family; all 3 regime strata present overall and within holdout; zero development/holdout start_date overlap per family; unique injection_id; required-field presence and type/nonempty validity; split/regime_stratum/outage_length/registered_by value validity; start_date ISO parse and weekend check; registered_at exact ISO-8601-UTC format check; reason_code_contract exact-value match against the closed mapping (not just key presence); every entry's start_date verified present as a real row in every declared contract's actual pinned snapshot file, derived dynamically from the manifest; real surrounding-gap check (>4 calendar days) against those same rows.

verification_notes: Row presence for every anchor date in this registry has been directly confirmed via local file checks, and is now additionally enforced automatically by the verifier (coverage_verification above) rather than only asserted in prose.

Per Section 4.1's clarification, live-FRED historical publication/arrival timestamp reconstruction is not required for injection eligibility — synthetic injections simulate a fetch outage (condition (b) by construction), not a claim about the provider's actual historical arrival time. Resolved by specification.
